row:
Blind Cat Rescue and Sanctuary fulfills the need for a safe haven for blind, FIV+ (Feline Immunodeficiency Virus) and FELV+ (Feline Leukemia) cats that are deemed unadoptable by regular shelters and at risk for euthanization because they are blind, FIV+, and/or FELV+. If you believe that these cats deserve to have an opportunity to live rather than be euthanized, please help us have the resources to help them.

We are a registered non-profit with the state of North Carolina. We are a 501(c)(3). Our tax number is 20-3410498, and all donations are tax deductible.
